subject: Alpha3 runtime landed on main; earlier deployment-gap finding is superseded
body: STARTING main for this session was efb6be2a99a65d3f432b3bac42b16e296b25b640. During discovery, GitHub main advanced to 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70 (Make Fold7 hinge authority explicit and ordered). Compared with efb6be2, main is now 2 commits ahead and includes app/src/main/java/com/duoopen/fold/Fold7AngleAuthority.kt, Fold7HingeIngressBatch.kt, service-owned authoritative hinge delivery, ordered source-time ingress, DuoApp service angle consumption, 60-degree shader producer alignment, explicit linear BitmapShader input filtering, and focused tests. Therefore research-rd-01's 02:38Z finding that Alpha3 support was present but runtime was not committed was correct for efb6be2 but is now historical. Direct private-sensor feasibility remains unresolved and is still owned by research-rd-01.
